comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Going to borrow Alrn's format here... thanks in advance. Can be obtained from Temple of Poseidon hidden room chests. Part of Memorial Album "Treasure in a Mythical Temple".
Stats : Durability 50/50. Formality 10. Defense Power 10. +1 Theology, Biology, and Sniping. Required Total Fame 5000.

Note: None of the MA items from "Treasure in a Mythical Temple" appear from chests if you have "Between Myth and Reality" TH theme active. And of course, if Atlantis isn't in the server, you cannot begin/complete the MA since access to its dungeon becomes impossible until it returns. Cheers.

comments.author: Guilder
